PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Sidoarjo
Engineering Support & Analyst Officer

Job Responsibilities

• Conduct detailed and comprehensive comparisons and evaluations of technical data to support project and production activities.
• Analyze technical specifications, equipment performance, engineering methods, and operational requirements to support informed decision-making.
• Prepare, process, and present engineering data through reports, diagrams, charts, and dashboards.
• Monitor project implementation in terms of technical requirements, schedules, and budget compliance.
• Coordinate with engineering, production, procurement, and other related teams to ensure alignment with project specifications and objectives.
• Support project evaluations by performing data analysis, identifying risks, and recommending continuous improvements.
• Maintain complete, accurate, and well-organized technical documentation and reports.
• Provide analytical and administrative support for engineering activities in accordance with company standards.

Job Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or other related disciplines.
• Experience in project environments and/or manufacturing operations is preferred.
• Strong technical analytical skills with the ability to evaluate specifications, project timelines, and budgets.
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel for data processing, analysis, and reporting.
• Familiar with creating engineering diagrams, charts, and presentation materials.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to convey technical information effectively.
• Able to work collaboratively in a team environment as well as independently with high attention to detail.
• Possess excellent problem-solving, analytical thinking, and time management skills.




PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Sidoarjo
Engineering Support & Analyst Officer

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

• Melakukan komparasi dan evaluasi data teknis secara detail, akurat, dan menyeluruh untuk mendukung kegiatan proyek maupun operasional produksi.
• Menganalisis spesifikasi teknis, performa peralatan, metode kerja, dan kebutuhan engineering sebagai dasar pengambilan keputusan.
• Menyusun, mengolah, dan mempresentasikan data engineering dalam bentuk laporan, diagram, grafik, dan dashboard yang informatif.
• Memantau pelaksanaan proyek berdasarkan aspek teknis, timeline, dan anggaran yang telah ditetapkan.
• Berkoordinasi dengan tim engineering, produksi, procurement, dan pihak terkait lainnya untuk memastikan kesesuaian spesifikasi dan target pekerjaan.
• Mendukung proses evaluasi proyek melalui analisis data, identifikasi risiko, dan rekomendasi perbaikan berkelanjutan.
• Memastikan seluruh dokumentasi teknis dan laporan tersusun dengan baik, lengkap, dan mudah ditelusuri.
• Memberikan dukungan administratif dan analitis untuk kegiatan engineering sesuai standar perusahaan.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

• Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik atau jurusan lain yang relevan.
• Memiliki pengalaman di lingkungan proyek maupun operasional produksi menjadi nilai tambah.
• Memiliki kemampuan analisis teknis yang kuat dan mampu melakukan evaluasi spesifikasi, timeline, serta budget proyek.
• Mampu mengolah, menganalisis, dan menyajikan data menggunakan Microsoft Excel secara efektif.
• Memahami pembuatan diagram, grafik, dan presentasi data engineering.
• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dalam menyampaikan informasi teknis kepada berbagai pihak.
• Mampu bekerja secara tim maupun mandiri dengan orientasi pada hasil dan ketelitian tinggi.
• Memiliki kemampuan problem solving, berpikir analitis, dan manajemen waktu yang baik.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
